Reading for the seat (no code change, no push) · the residual shape in 6841146506 · 2026-11-13T19:47Z

Verdict: **(b) main's and unchanged by PR #33148, outside this card.**

Shape driven (objectql exact-qualifier harness double, scratch file deleted after): App A, its pair `A.custom`; W (`com.other.wolf`, a module on A and X, own namespace) registers the `de-DE` member of email template `welcome`; a stored row of `A.custom` for `de-DE` declares `overrides.package: X`; the seal runs; X then arrives with `en-US` and is refused at the item door ("Bare-name conflict … already holds", X's manifest installed) and at the package door (X not installed). Same cells at both doors.

| Cell | `origin/main` copies of the two source files | head `72c8a9c8ef` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| holders | `[W]` | `[W]` |
| registry item at W, `de-DE` | W's own (`wolf de-DE`) | same |
| `overlayRowBinding` of the row | n/a | `undefined` (no package) |
| `?package=W&member=de-DE` | the row declared for X, stamped W | same |
| W's list / execution list | carry the row | same |
| `?package=X&member=de-DE` | 409 naming W | same |
| `?package=A.custom&member=de-DE` | the row, stamped W | same |

So W's exact address, list and execution list serve a row declared for a package that holds nothing, while the registry binds it to no package: the read note holds as written, on main and at this head alike. The row declares its base, and this PR changes only the reading of undeclared pair rows, so it does not move. Which read path serves it was not diagnosed. Not probed: the protocol's save door (the row was hydrated as stored), a cold boot.
